title: Speed vs Velocity
subject: Physics
objective: Two cars at the same 60 km/h can have different velocities. Speed tells how fast; velocity also tells which way.

fill.q: The SI unit of speed and velocity is ____.

tf.q: Two cars at 60 km/h in opposite directions have the same velocity.
tf.explain: Same speed, but opposite directions mean different velocities.

tf.q: An object moving in a circle at constant speed has a changing velocity.

tf.explain: Speed has no direction; it is a scalar.

ar.a: A body moving with constant speed can have a changing velocity.
ar.r: Velocity depends on direction as well as speed.
ar.explain: Circular motion is the example; R explains it.
A is false (speed has no direction); R is true.

mcq.q: A car goes round a circular track at a steady 40 km/h. Its velocity is:
Speed and velocity have the same magnitude when motion is:
options: in a straight line, one direction

num.q: A car covers 180 km in 2.5 h. Find its speed in km/h and m/s.
A runner goes 100 m north in 12.5 s. Find speed and velocity.
steps: Velocity = 8 m/s towards the north (same magnitude, with direction)

short.q: Distinguish speed and velocity with one example.
short.solution: Speed = distance/time, no direction (scalar). Velocity = displacement/time, with direction (vector). Example: 50 km/h is a speed; 50 km/h east is a velocity.

short.q: Convert 90 km/h into m/s and 15 m/s into km/h.

match.explain: Velocity changes whenever speed or direction changes.
